entries.title: Amos 7:1
segments:
CHAP. VII. 
 
  Threatened judgments turned aside by the prayer of Amos, ver. 1-6.   Yet at length they are sentenced to utter ruin, ver. 7-9.   Amaziah accuses Amos, ver. 10-13.   Amos justifies himself and denounces the judgment of God against   Amaziah, ver. 14-17. 
 
  V. 1. Thus-This is the first of five prophetic representations of what was coming upon this people.  The latter growth-The shooting up of the first growth being too luxuriant, they often eat it down with cattle; but if the second growth were eat up, it marred the whole harvest. Mowed-It is supposed the first mowing of the corn in the blade was for the king's use; and after this the second springing grew up to the harvest.

entries.title: Amos 7:2
segments: V. 2. It came to pass-In the vision.  By whom-How shall any of Jacob escape, if thou dost cast him down?

entries.title: Amos 7:3
segments: V. 3. Repented-This is spoken after the manner of men.

entries.title: Amos 7:4
segments: V. 4. Shewed-In vision.  Called-Commanded fire from heaven. A part-Of the land too.

entries.title: Amos 7:7
segments: V. 7. By a plumb-line-Strongly and beautifully built.

entries.title: Amos 7:8
segments: V. 8. Set a plumb-line-I will exactly measure the whole ten tribes. Pass by them-I will no more forbear, but will pull down all that is faulty.

entries.title: Amos 7:9
segments: V. 9. The high places-The temples on high mountains built to idols. Of Isaac-The seed of Isaac.

entries.title: Amos 7:10
segments: V. 10. In the midst-Openly, and publickly, endeavouring to stir up Israel to sedition or rebellion.  The land-The people cannot bear all his harsh predictions.

entries.title: Amos 7:11
segments: V. 11. Jeroboam shall die-He nowhere said so, but spake of his house distinguished from his person, as ver.

entries.title: Amos 7:13
segments: V. 13. The king's court-To which therefore thou oughtest to shew more respect, and not thus to affront the king in his own house.

entries.title: Amos 7:14
segments: V. 14. No prophet-Not originally, or by study, or by any human designation.  An herdman-By breeding and occupation I was and still am, an herdman.  Sycamore fruit-This fruit was good food for man, or cattle.

entries.title: Amos 7:16
segments: V. 16. The house of Isaac-The posterity of Isaac.

entries.title: Amos 7:17
segments: V. 17. In a polluted land-Among the Heathen. Israel-The ten tribes.
